fields.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Quinn''' {{tip|dashes}} to the target enemy, marking them with ''{{ai|Harrier|Quinn}}'', dealing {{as|physical damage}}, {{tip|airborne|knocking them back}} a very short distance over {{fd|0.5}} seconds, and {{tip|slow|slowing}} them by 50% decaying over {{fd|1.5}} seconds. She then {{tip|dash|leaps back}} 525 units away from them.
fields.description2: ''Vault {{tip|basic attack reset|resets}} '''Quinn's''' basic attack timer {{tt|shortly after|See notes}} the initial dash. {{ai|Heightened Senses|Quinn}} can be cast during either of the dashes.''
